en: A black-and-white postcard view over a coastal village built on rocky terrain. Numerous wooden houses with pitched roofs are clustered along narrow streets, with telephone poles and sparse vegetation visible. In the background is a calm body of water with rocky islands or shoreline beyond. The caption "Södra Grundsund" appears at the lower left and a small publisher's logo with the number 214 appears at the lower right.
